explicitLimits.classification: Dormant default declarations; no production dispatch promises automatic delivery. No fabricated direct-call tests counted as lifecycle evidence.

Unsupported default methods returning NotImplemented and model accessors are not asserted individually. Generated SQLx/SeaORM consumers, missing manual additional-field bindings, and authoritative missing-record behavior have executable owners.

explicitLimits.surface: FieldConfig output validator and async validator
explicitLimits.classification: Output validator is declared metadata and intentionally not invoked. Async input validators invoke the callback but reject futures as ASYNC_VALIDATION_NOT_SUPPORTED; they do not support asynchronous admission.
Native tests use real HTTP/TLS-independent local protocol servers and independent signatures. They do not prove external provider availability, credentials, or future protocol changes.

Contract coverage is not exhaustive execution of every input, arbitrary application callback, or Cartesian product of configuration switches. Test count and line execution alone do not establish contract completeness.

Three partial application-schema examples in src/lib.rs, crates/seaorm-macros/src/lib.rs and crates/sqlx-macros/src/lib.rs need user-owned model modules. Six executable/compile-fail doctests pass; real generated consumer integration owners compile and migrate both adapters on SQLite/PostgreSQL.

Remaining line gaps include default no-op callback methods, unsupported optional trait capabilities, derive declarations/Debug formatting/accessors, defensive infrastructure failures, and alternate input/configuration branches within owned contracts. See current.json for exact line locations. Reviewed contract ownership does not imply 100% branch or line execution.

reviewCorrections.finding: A 350ms window could legitimately expire during 32 concurrent SQL admissions. A full run exposed 4 allowed requests instead of 3.

reviewCorrections.correction: Actual signed ceremonies upgrade eligibility first, then set and clear backup state; UV-denied controls otherwise preserve admissible inputs.
